description: Angular component class for configuring range chart widget settings in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, validation, and preview functions.

classes.name: RangeChartWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing range chart widget settings, including form controls, validation, and preview functions.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes form controls based on provided widget settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Dynamically enables/disables form controls based on current form values.

methods.name: onSettingsChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when widget settings change, updating data keys accordingly.

methods.name: _pointLabelPreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for point labels based on current configuration.

methods.name: _tooltipValuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for tooltip values based on current configuration.

methods.name: _tooltipDatePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a formatted date preview for tooltips based on current configuration.
